highlights: Third episode titled File 3: The Love Letter premiered on YouTube
The series uses AI to craft short crime stories released weekly
Investigators find a hidden code in a seemingly old romantic letter
The episode blends murder mystery with family dynamics

delusion_thai_thriller_release.headline: Thai Crime Thriller “Delusion” Set for September 2026 Netflix Release
delusion_thai_thriller_release.summary: Netflix has confirmed that the Thai original series Delusion will premiere globally on September 24, 2026.
highlights: Delusion is a Thai crime thriller co‑written and directed by Au Chayan Laoyodtrakool
The series follows high school teacher Wan as she investigates her father’s murder suspicion
Netflix confirmed the worldwide release date as September 24, 2026

tax_credit_cap_amendment.headline: California Lawmakers Advance Trailer Bill to Amend Production Tax Incentive
tax_credit_cap_amendment.summary: Lawmakers introduced Assembly Bill 186 to modify California’s production tax incentive program amid concerns over the new $5 million cap.
highlights: SB 122 caps tax credits at $5 million or 70% of liability per year
AB 186 would speed refund payouts from five to two years and reduce the discount from 10% to 5%
The bill extends carry‑forward of credits from 10 to 15 years
Independent productions are exempt from the new annual cap

original_twilight_zone_pilot.headline: Original Twilight Zone Pilot Rejected for Being Too Depressing
original_twilight_zone_pilot.summary: Rod Serling's first script titled "The Happy Place" was turned down by CBS executives for its bleak premise before the series launched.
highlights: The pilot script depicted a future where people were executed at age 60
CBS executive Bill Self deemed the story too downbeat to sell as a series
Serling rewrote the concept, leading to the debut of "Where Is Everybody?"
The rejected script’s themes resurfaced in later episodes like "The Obsolete Man"
